title: The Making
haiku:
Sky pours without end,
hold the line, let it unfold
dawn keeps its own word.

title: The Receiving Earth
haiku:
Earth yields, wide and dark,
follow the mare, don't lead her
stillness finds the friend.

title: The First Awakening
haiku:
Roots strain through hard ground,
don't force the seed, call for help
the plant knows its hour.

title: The Dark Mind
haiku:
The unlearned come first,
one clear word is enough here
ask again, hear none.

title: The Waiting
haiku:
Wait, sincere and still,
light gathers behind the clouds
then ford the wide stream.

title: The Clash
haiku:
Truth meets a closed door,
stop halfway, don't force it through
seek the steady one.

title: The Multitude
haiku:
Ranks need a firm hand,
and the patience of a march
order becomes strength.

title: The Union
haiku:
Bonds ask to be proven,
ask again if the ground holds
the late come to grief.

title: The Small Hoard
haiku:
Small force holds back much,
clouds thicken, no rain falls yet
the west stays parched, still.

title: The Stepping
haiku:
You step on the tiger,
it does not turn to bite you
walk on, unafraid.

title: The Great Calm
haiku:
What was small departs,
what is great is drawing near
the balance holds firm.

title: The Sealed Silence
haiku:
Bad company blocks,
the greater leaves, the lesser stays
hold nothing, wait still.

title: Kinship Under Open Sky
haiku:
Gather in open ground,
cross the water together now
steady hearts prevail.

title: The Great Possession
haiku:
What you hold runs deep,
more than measure ever could
it comes without strain.

title: The Humble
haiku:
The low ground gathers
what the high peaks let fall off
the humble finish.

title: The Fervor
haiku:
Joy moves the army,
name someone to hold the line
and let the march begin.

title: The Following
haiku:
Bend like the willow,
follow where the current pulls
no blame in bending.

title: The Mending
haiku:
Rot asks to be named,
three days before, three days after
mend it in its time.

title: The Drawing Near
haiku:
Draw close while you can,
the season turns, the eighth month comes
with its own weather.

title: The Gaze
haiku:
Washed clean, not yet fed,
still the people watch and wait
trusting what they see.

title: The Biting Through
haiku:
Cut through what resists,
let the true account be heard
justice clears the path.

title: The Grace
haiku:
Small things wear their best,
a good coat for a short walk
beauty in the near.

title: The Shedding
haiku:
The structure gives way,
there is nowhere left to go now
stay, and hold your ground.

title: The Return
haiku:
Out and back again,
no error in the turning
the seventh day comes home.

title: The Unforced
haiku:
Move without pretense,
but false steps still bring their weight
don't force what won't grow.

title: The Great Holding
haiku:
Great strength holds itself,
eat away from your own table
then cross the wide stream.

title: The Nourishing Mouth
haiku:
Watch what feeds the mouth,
and what the mouth is feeding
tend your own hunger too.

title: The Great Excess
haiku:
The beam bends too far,
this hour asks a rare courage
walk on, it will hold.

title: The Deep Abyss
haiku:
Deep water, deep water,
a sincere heart still finds bottom
what you do, it holds.

title: The Radiance
haiku:
Cling to what gives light,
tend it the way you'd tend
a cow, slow and sure.

title: The Resonance
haiku:
Something moves unspoken
between two before they touch
say yes to the pull.

title: The Enduring
haiku:
What lasts stays in motion,
no blame in the steady turning
keep walking somewhere.

title: The Retreat
haiku:
Step back while you can,
in small things, this is the strength
don't push, just withdraw.

title: The Great Strength
haiku:
Great strength held too loose
becomes a ram caught in hedge
hold it, don't display.

title: The Advance
haiku:
Horses in numbers,
thrice granted the royal ear
honor comes today.

title: The Darkening of Light
haiku:
The light goes under,
stay true when you cannot see
the dark does not last.

title: The Household
haiku:
The hearth holds the house,
her steadiness sets its measure
all things find their place.

title: The Divergence
haiku:
Two ways face away,
small matters still turn out well
apart, then aligned.

title: The Obstruction
haiku:
The path west opens,
the path northeast stays closed off
find the steady one.

title: The Release
haiku:
The knot comes undone,
go home if the road is finished
hurry if it's not.

title: The Diminishing
haiku:
Give with a true heart,
two small bowls are enough here
less becomes a gift.

title: The Increase
haiku:
More comes to your hands,
take up the task in front of you
and cross the deep stream.

title: The Resolve
haiku:
Name the danger loud,
at the court, in the open air
but lay down the sword.

title: The Encounter
haiku:
She's strong on the road,
but not the one to bring home
walk on, let her pass.

title: The Gathering
haiku:
They gather at the shrine,
bring what is worth the offering
the great one will come.

title: The Rising
haiku:
Climb without your fear,
toward whoever stands above
go south, it will hold.

title: The Exhaustion
haiku:
Pressed from every side,
the steady one still finds fortune
though no one will hear.

title: The Well
haiku:
The town may be rebuilt,
but the well beneath stays the same
don't let the rope run short.

title: The Molting
haiku:
On your own true day,
they will believe what you say
regret falls away.

title: The Renewed Vessel
haiku:
The vessel holds fire
and turns raw things into feast
it brings its own luck.

title: The Awakening Thunder
haiku:
Thunder splits the sky,
laughter follows the alarm
the cup stays steady.

title: The Stillness
haiku:
Hold the back quite still,
until the body falls away
step past your own house.

title: The Gradual Advance
haiku:
Slow as a bride's walk,
step by step toward the promise
patience finds its shape.

title: The Given-Away Sister
haiku:
Given, not choosing,
to act here brings only harm
let the moment pass.

title: The Abundance
haiku:
The king's house is full,
grieve nothing, be unclouded
like sun at high noon.

title: The Wanderer
haiku:
A stranger passing,
stay small, keep your manners close
and grace will find you.

title: The Gentle Yielding
haiku:
Wind moves the small things,
go where you are called to go
and meet who you seek.

title: The Gladness
haiku:
Delight, held with care,
patience keeps the gladness whole
joy that doesn't spend.

title: The Dissolving
haiku:
What was tight lets go,
the king still walks to his shrine
cross the water now.

title: The Measure
haiku:
A measure keeps shape,
but grip it too hard, it breaks
hold the line, not tight.

title: The Inner Truth
haiku:
Truth reaches the pig,
and the fish beneath the ice
cross the water sure.

title: The Small Excess
haiku:
The bird flies too high,
its message is: stay closer
small wins, not the sky.

title: After Completion
haiku:
It's finished, mostly,
good fortune found at the start
but watch how it ends.

title: Before Completion
haiku:
The fox nears the bank,
its tail dips wet in the stream
not finished, not lost.
